notes: Post-harvest and post-fast-scan now reliably trigger a staleness check of the slow-crawl enrichment group (firmware baselines, EOA/IMT, switch firmware, new-platform/hardware discovery), which previously only ran on its own independent 7-day timer -- a fleet syncing constantly could otherwise go a full week without platform/switch/firmware data ever being checked for freshness. Also fixed two live JS bugs: 'fpTiered is not defined' crashing the CSM tab's Data Protection checklist (variable was block-scoped to an if/else branch it was used outside of) and 'csvContent is not defined' crashing Clear Watchlists (stray leftover line from an unrelated CSV-export function).
